_how: Share-card theme by game date (America/New_York). Dates in "rivalry" use the white rivalry-jersey look: <key>-rivalry.webp backgrounds, icy white fade, royal-blue type, jersey-style numerals. Remove the date (or leave it; it only matches that day) to go back to the usual look. Dates in "bg" swap the default Allen image for that day's background key (e.g. share-bg-thanksgiving); needs the share.js day-background update.
